summary: Moves Control Panel pairing into Admin commands and refreshes the page with native DjangoLux fields, status, and feedback.
highlights: Rejected HTTP control-panel URLs now display the HTTPS validation error.
Accepted pairing and cancellation actions display native DjangoLux flash feedback.
Pairing feedback no longer depends on the disabled-by-default legacy Django message bridge.
The Control Panel launcher now lives in Admin commands instead of the Options card grid.
The pairing page now uses responsive DjangoLux form, connection, and bridge-status surfaces.
